summary: Keep the Kelowna and Vernon Hospitals Project as an active Canadian social-infrastructure PPP with Infusion Health KVH General Partnership as the legal ProjectCo. Direct evidence shows BBGI acquired 50% in 2013, acquired the remaining 50% on August 19, 2020 and continued to describe the ProjectCo as wholly owned in April 2026. Retire Equitix and Dalmore after August 19, 2020 while preserving their indirect Jura/JLIF history. BCI's 2025 acquisition of BBGI is upstream and does not create a separate ProjectCo ownership period.
